exposure: Vaginal delivery of the second twin simulation program
outcome: Residents' personal feelings about their ability to perform maneuvers
Residents' technical skills in performing maneuvers
Perception of model realism and session usefulness
Perception of simulation as an essential part of learning
cohort: Ten obstetric and gynecology residents participated in a simulation program at a tertiary level university maternity hospital.
finding: Residents' personal feelings about their ability to perform the maneuvers increased significantly after participation in the simulation session, and their technical skills were assessed, with participants finding the model realistic and the session useful.
